automatable_note: The button on the ESC must be pressed after the 2 s wait. The bench has no actuator for it.

manual.action: Press the button marked Taster on the label after 2 s or the tone sequence.
manual.action_de: Taster mit der Aufschrift Taster nach 2 s oder der Tonfolge drücken.

entry.confirm_signal: Ascending tone sequence after the wait; descending tone sequence after the button.
steps: Connect the motor if tones are to be audible. Transmitter on, throttle to the brake position (stick back).
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds an ascending tone sequence.
Operator: press and release the button marked 'Taster' on the ESC label.
The ESC sounds a descending tone sequence, then the mode series with pauses between series (mode 7 after 7 tones, mode 9 after 9 tones).
Move the throttle to full (stick forward) when the wanted mode sounds. The ESC confirms with a descending tone sequence.

Mode 2 only: move the throttle to the brake position (stick back); the ESC confirms with a descending sequence. Then optionally move to a separate motor-off position (stick middle); the ESC confirms again.
Control output: the mode is repeated as tones. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds.

scheme.confirm_signal: Descending tone sequence, then the mode as tones.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power after the control output.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Program mode 1 (APM); it clears all settings.
scheme.description: Throttle at brake, power on, wait 2 s or until the ascending sequence, press the ESC button. The ESC counts modes as tones. Full throttle at the wanted mode stores it. Modes 7 and 9 are added on top of another stored mode.

values.name: APM: reset, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: EMK brake and undervoltage cutoff on, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, undervoltage reduction instead of cutoff
LiPo undervoltage detection: switches between 0.7 to 0.8 V per NiCd/NiMH cell and 2.7 to 3 V per LiPo cell

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Exact timing of the 'wait 2 s or until the tone sequence' step is not stated beyond the 2 s minimum; the end of the wait is the ESC's tone sequence.
Model-specific data of PIX 1000, 3000 and 4000 differ in the type names only; the manuals print one data set.
Position of the button on the ESC is given only as the 'Taster' label.
notes: Kontronik_Pix1000_3000.pdf and Kontronik_Pix4000.pdf print the same technical data and procedures; the PIX 4000 manual adds ProgCARD notes.
Modes 7 and 9 do not change other stored settings; the PIX manuals do not state a prerequisite for them.

Mode 2 moves the stick to the brake position (back) after the full-throttle selection, and the ESC answers with a descending tone sequence (Kontronik_Pix1000_3000.pdf p.5 steps 9-10 DE, p.11 EN): after_select min. The optional separate motor-off position (steps 11-12) is not made. The manual gives no time for the move; stick programming makes it STORE after the selection.
